name: Camping Guggemos
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Guggemos is located in Füssen in the Austrian state of Tyrol. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans, as well as a camping meadow for tents. Facilities include sanitary blocks, a waste disposal and supply station, and a small convenience store. Its peaceful location on the outskirts of town provides direct access to cycling and hiking trails. Guests can reach the royal palaces and Lake Forggensee in a short drive. The campsite is open from April to October and offers a bread roll service. Free Wi-Fi is available across the entire site.
